sentences.zh: 我们从

sentences.en: China where embattled real estate giant Evergrande faces a major moment of truth this week.
sentences.zh: 中国开始，陷入困境的房地产巨头恒大本周面临着一个重大的真相时刻。

sentences.en: One of the biggest and most important corporations in China, which both fueled and profited from the country's historic housing boom.
sentences.zh: 它是中国规模最大、最重要的企业之一，既推动了中国历史性的房地产繁荣，也从中获利。

sentences.en: Shares in the highly indebted company have fallen
sentences.zh: 这家负债累累的公司的股价今年已经下跌了

sentences.en: 80% this year.
sentences.zh: 今年占了80%。

sentences.en: Is now on the brink of collapse.
sentences.zh: 现在正处于崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Analysts fear the crisis could spread throughout
sentences.zh: 分析人士担心，这场危机可能会蔓延到

sentences.en: China's property sector and the entire economy.
sentences.zh: 中国的整个房地产行业乃至整个经济。

sentences.en: Raising fears of a broader financial crisis in a country that prides itself on stability and control.
sentences.zh: 这引发了人们对一个以稳定和控制自居的国家可能爆发更广泛金融危机的担忧。

sentences.en: Evergrande was always thought to be too big to fail.
sentences.zh: 恒大一直被认为“大而不能倒”。

sentences.en: Now, where have we heard that one before?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们以前在哪里听过这句话呢？

sentences.en: Today, I spoke to my colleague,
sentences.zh: 今天，我采访了我的同事，

sentences.en: Alexandra Stevenson, about the rise and fall of Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉·史蒂文森，谈论恒大的兴衰。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月25日，星期一。

sentences.en: Alex, most of us have never heard of this company, Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我们大多数人以前从未听说过恒大这家公司。

sentences.en: But my sense is that if you live in
sentences.zh: 但我的感觉是，如果你住在

sentences.en: China, it's a household name.
sentences.zh: 中国，这可是家喻户晓的名字。

sentences.en: And I know that you have been reporting on this company for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道你报道这家公司已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: So what should we know about it?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该了解它什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, Evergrande is a household name in China.
sentences.zh: 是的，恒大在中国确实家喻户晓。

sentences.en: It's actually one of the country's most prolific developers.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是中国最活跃的开发商之一。

sentences.en: And its properties are in hundreds of cities across the country.
sentences.zh: 它的楼盘遍布全国数百个城市。

sentences.en: Its rise and the rise of its founder, Shu Jiayin, really mirrors that of
sentences.zh: 它的崛起以及创始人许家印的崛起，确实反映了

sentences.en: China's entire economy.
sentences.zh: 中国整个经济的发展。

sentences.en: And it tells the story of China's early embrace of capitalism.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了中国早期拥抱资本主义的故事。

sentences.en: And Shu's story is also really interesting.
sentences.zh: 许家印的故事也非常有趣。

sentences.en: He grew up poor in a rural village in the central province of Henan.
sentences.zh: 他在河南省中部的一个农村长大，家境贫寒。

sentences.en: He has described in speeches memories of eating sweet potatoes and sweet potato flour and just being
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中描述过吃红薯和红薯粉的记忆，只是

sentences.en: sick of sweet potatoes and studying under a thatched roof that didn't keep out wind or rain.
sentences.zh: 吃腻了红薯，还在漏风漏雨的茅草屋下学习。

sentences.en: He has described how he went on to become a steel factory technician at a state-owned enterprise because it was still at a time when China's economy was mostly centrally planned.
sentences.zh: 他描述了自己后来是如何成为一家国有企业的钢铁厂技术员的，因为当时中国的经济主要还是计划经济。

sentences.en: But as he's sort of going through those early years in the workforce, China's beginning to talk about opening up.
sentences.zh: 但随着他在职场度过早年岁月，中国开始谈论开放。

sentences.en: And in 1996, a little more than a decade after he starts out, he decides he's going to set up
sentences.zh: 1996年，在他起步十多年后，他决定在深圳市建立

sentences.en: his own business in the city of Shenzhen, which at the time was a special economic zone that China's
sentences.zh: 自己的企业，当时深圳是中国领导人

sentences.en: leader, Deng Xiaoping, had first chosen as the place to launch an experiment with capitalism.
sentences.zh: 邓小平最初选择作为开展资本主义实验的地方，是一个经济特区。

sentences.en: And so Evergrande is born there.
sentences.zh: 于是恒大就在那里诞生了。

sentences.en: And so at that time, China was just embarking on this massive project of moving hundreds of millions
sentences.zh: 当时，中国正着手进行一项宏大的工程，将数以亿计的

sentences.en: of people from the countryside to the cities and creating new cities out of dirt villages.
sentences.zh: 人口从农村迁往城市，并从泥土村庄中创造出新的城市。

sentences.en: And as they're doing that, Xu is selling the dream of home ownership to a very small but starting to grow middle class.
sentences.zh: 在他们这样做的时候，许家印正在向一个规模很小但开始增长的中产阶级兜售住房梦。

sentences.en: And as China urbanizes, Evergrande kind of expands beyond Shenzhen to really all corners
sentences.zh: 随着中国城市化进程的推进，恒大从深圳扩展到了

sentences.en: of China, building towards this, what ends up being this remarkable property boom that China sees for decades.
sentences.zh: 中国的各个角落，最终形成了中国几十年来所见的那种非凡的房地产繁荣。

sentences.en: Describe that property boom.
sentences.zh: 描述一下那种房地产繁荣。

sentences.en: China's property boom has been a wild ride.
sentences.zh: 中国的房地产繁荣是一场疯狂的旅程。

sentences.en: Skyscrapers, shopping malls, high-speed trains, even new cities are popping up.
sentences.zh: 摩天大楼、购物中心、高铁，甚至新城市如雨后春笋般涌现。

sentences.en: Every year, 20 new cities are built from scratch in China, each with more than a million people.
sentences.zh: 中国每年从零开始建造20座新城市，每座城市都有超过一百万人口。

sentences.en: And for anybody who's ever gotten on a train and gone from one city to another in China, you can see cranes dot the skyline amid new plazas, parks and housing developments.
sentences.zh: 对于任何在中国坐火车从一个城市到另一个城市的人来说，你都能看到天际线上点缀着起重机，周围是新的广场、公园和住宅开发项目。

sentences.en: Just hundreds of cranes as you come into any city and huge sprawling property developments always under construction.
sentences.zh: 当你进入任何城市时，都能看到数百台起重机，巨大的房地产开发项目总是在建设中。

sentences.en: Just in the last few years, China has used more cement than the United States did in the entire last century.
sentences.zh: 仅在过去几年里，中国使用的水泥就比美国整个上个世纪使用的还要多。

sentences.en: One of the things the first time that I went to Beijing in the mid-2000s was just being shocked that
sentences.zh: 2000年代中期我第一次去北京时，最让我震惊的一件事就是

sentences.en: one week there's just like a dirt plot and then the next week something is there in its place, multi-story building.
sentences.zh: 前一周还是一块空地，下一周原址上就出现了多层建筑。

sentences.en: And it's just the skeleton, but it's already gone up.
sentences.zh: 虽然只是骨架，但已经建起来了。

sentences.en: And a lot of the property developers in China will throw up these towering banners with images of Central Park
sentences.zh: 中国的许多房地产开发商会挂出高耸的横幅，上面印着中央公园

sentences.en: or kind of iconic places around the world in major cities to sort of associate themselves with success.
sentences.zh: 或世界各地主要城市标志性地点的图片，以此来将自己与成功联系起来。

sentences.en: And Evergrande itself was selling this lifestyle associated with names like Cloud Lake Royal Garden,
sentences.zh: 恒大本身也在兜售与“恒大金碧天下”、“御景湾”、“豪宅宫殿”等名字相关的生活方式。

sentences.en: Empire View, Luxury Palace.
sentences.zh: 享受受欢迎的国际学区带来的良好声誉。

sentences.en: Enjoying a good reputation for the popular international school district.
sentences.zh: 所以许家印和恒大是那场繁荣的一部分，向正在壮大的中产阶级兜售这种理念。

sentences.en: And so Shoe and Evergrande were part of that boom of selling this idea to what was becoming a burgeoning middle class.
sentences.zh: 恒大，不同寻常。

sentences.en: Evergrande Legault, out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来他们不仅是在卖公寓，还在非常有效地兜售一种成功和幸福的理念。

sentences.en: So they're not just selling apartments, it sounds like they're selling an idea of success and happiness very effectively.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们兜售的是财富，这种关于财富和繁荣的理念。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're selling wealth, this idea of wealth and prosperity.
sentences.zh: 不知不觉中，恒大已经在全国建造了数百万套公寓。

sentences.en: And suddenly before you know it, Evergrande has built millions of individual apartments across the country.
sentences.zh: 到了2009年，它的规模已经大到决定在香港上市，并筹集了超过7亿美元的资金。

sentences.en: And so by 2009, it's big enough that it decides to go public in Hong Kong and it raises over $700 million.
sentences.zh: 这为来自华尔街和中国以外其他全球金融中心的融资打开了全新的大门。

sentences.en: And this opens up the doors to a whole new world of financing from Wall Street and from other global financial capitals outside of China.
sentences.zh: 这也是许家印开始涉足新业务领域并进行“奖杯式”收购的时候。

sentences.en: And it's also when Shoe starts to dabble in new areas of business and he starts to make trophy purchases.
sentences.zh: 我们先从足球和中超球队广州恒大说起。

sentences.en: We're going to start with football and Chinese side Guangzhou Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 就像2010年的一支足球队。

sentences.en: Like a soccer team in 2010.
sentences.zh: 今天他们以创纪录的转会费签下了哥伦比亚前锋杰克逊·马丁内斯。

sentences.en: Today they signed Colombian forward Jackson Martinez for a record fee.
sentences.zh: 他为外籍球员砸下了数百万美元。

sentences.en: And he's dumping up millions of dollars for foreign players.
sentences.zh: 这笔来自马德里竞技的转会是中超联赛历史上最大的一笔。

sentences.en: The transfer from Atletico Madrid is the biggest in the history of the Chinese Super League.
sentences.zh: 然后他进入了乳制品行业，接着是石油和养猪业。

sentences.en: And he gets into dairy and then he gets into oil and pig farming.
sentences.zh: 最终，他甚至创办了一家电动汽车公司，承诺要比特斯拉更大、更好。

sentences.en: And eventually, he even starts an electric vehicle company that promised to be bigger and better than Tesla.
sentences.zh: 中国商人沈栋最近的回忆录里有这样一个场景。

sentences.en: And there's this scene in a recent memoir from a Chinese businessman named Desmond Shum.
sentences.zh: 这本书叫《红色赌盘》。

sentences.en: The book is called Red Roulette.
sentences.zh: 书中，许家印和朋友们乘坐私人飞机旅行。

sentences.en: And in it, Shoe takes a trip on a private jet with some friends.
sentences.zh: 他们飞往巴黎。

sentences.en: They fly to Paris.
sentences.zh: 到达后，他们花了一个晚上喝掉了价值约10万美元的拉菲红酒。

sentences.en: And then when they get there, they spend an evening downing like $100,000 worth of Chateau Lafitte wine.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们去了法国里维埃拉，许家印考虑以1亿美元的价格买下一艘由香港大亨拥有的游艇。

sentences.en: And later, they take this trip to the French Riviera where Shoe is like considering buying a yacht for $100 million that's owned by this Hong Kong mogul.
sentences.zh: 在挥霍了10万美元的红酒后，又要买1亿美元的游艇。

sentences.en: $100 million yacht after a $100,000 wine spree.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于他职业生涯的这个阶段来说，这10万美元对他来说就像零花钱一样。

sentences.en: I mean, this is like $100,000 since Chum changed for this guy at this point in his career.
sentences.zh: 正是这个场景真正说明了许家印和他的公司是如何搭上中国这场前所未有的巨大房地产繁荣的顺风车的。

sentences.en: And it's this scene that kind of really illustrates just how Shoe and his company rode this tremendous property boom in China, unlike any that the world had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 而他正处于这场繁荣的中心。

sentences.en: And he was at the center of it.
sentences.zh: 到2018年，许家印已成为中国首富。

sentences.en: And by 2018, Shoe is China's richest man.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，房地产繁荣更多地建立在投机而非真实需求之上。

sentences.en: But the problem is, the property boom becomes based more on speculation than true demand.
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 在过去十年的某个时候，政府基本上失去了控制。

sentences.en: At some point in the past decade, basically, the government loses control.
sentences.zh: 正是恒大和其他开发商在推动房地产市场的投机活动。

sentences.en: And it's Evergrande and other developers who are actually fueling the speculative activity in the property market.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，这并不重要，因为每个人都在受益。

sentences.en: And for a while, it didn't matter because everyone was benefiting.
sentences.zh: 地方政府向开发商卖地，他们受益了。

sentences.en: So you had local governments who were selling land to developers who were benefiting.
sentences.zh: 投资者不断向恒大这样的公司放贷，他们受益了。

sentences.en: You had investors who kept lending to companies like Evergrande who were benefiting.
sentences.zh: 家庭储蓄几乎没有其他投资渠道，只能投入房地产。

sentences.en: And you had households who really had very few other options for where to put their savings, putting it into property.
sentences.zh: 他们也受益了，因为房价一直在不断上涨。

sentences.en: And they were benefiting because prices kept going up and up and up.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些投机活动导致中国的公寓数量超过了可能居住的人口数量。

sentences.en: But all that speculative activity led to more apartments in China than there are people who could possibly live in them.
sentences.zh: 这也创造了一些世界上最难以负担的房产。

sentences.en: And it also created some of the most unaffordable property in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以现在的情况是，刚起步的年轻人根本无法想象自己有一天能拥有一个可以称之为家的地方。

sentences.en: So now you have a situation where young people who are just starting out can't possibly imagine actually ever being able to own a place to call home.
sentences.zh: 所以他们很难看到事情正在好转。

sentences.en: So it's hard for them to see how things are getting better.
sentences.zh: 如果年轻人看不到未来的希望，那对共产党和整个政府来说就是一个更大的问题。

sentences.en: And if young people don't see possibility in their future, that causes a much bigger problem for the Communist Party and for the government as a whole.
sentences.zh: 所以问题在于恒大正在引领一场投机性房地产泡沫，而这导致了社会不平等。

sentences.en: So the problem is that Evergrande is leading a speculative housing bubble, and that is leading to social inequality.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 恒大的问题在于，在参与这场房地产泡沫的过程中，它借入了数额惊人的巨款。

sentences.en: And the problem for Evergrande was that in participating in this housing bubble, it had borrowed an unbelievably large amount of money.
$300 billion.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 这使它成为世界上负债最多的房地产开发商。

sentences.en: Making it the most indebted real estate developer in the world.
sentences.zh: 但随后2020年8月发生了，央行表示“适可而止”，

sentences.en: But then August 2020 happens, and the central bank goes, enough is enough,
sentences.zh: 基本上切断了对恒大等开发商的贷款，并迫使他们开始解决债务问题并开始偿还。

sentences.en: and basically cuts off lending to developers like Evergrande and forces them to start addressing their debt and start paying it off.
sentences.zh: 所以此时，恒大寻找现金的途径已经用尽。

sentences.en: So at this point, Evergrande is running out of options for ways to find cash.
sentences.zh: 银行不再向它放贷。

sentences.en: The banks are no longer lending to it.
sentences.zh: 所以恒大真的无路可走。

sentences.en: And so there's really nowhere for Evergrande to turn.
sentences.zh: 门外排着长队的人都在要钱，而且要求立刻偿还。

sentences.en: And a lot of people, a long line of people outside their door, asking for money and asking for it now.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来像是一家处于金融崩溃边缘的公司。

sentences.en: So this is starting to look like a company that's on the verge of financial collapse.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 世界是如何意识到这一点的呢？

sentences.en: And how does the world come to understand that?
sentences.zh: 其实直到今年8月，当局召集恒大开会时才意识到。

sentences.en: Well, it's actually not until this summer, in August, when authorities summon Evergrande in for this meeting.
sentences.zh: 之后他们发表了一份声明，简短而生硬，但暗示了北京是如何看待恒大的，

sentences.en: And then they issue a statement afterwards, and it's short and terse, but it hints at how Beijing sees Evergrande,
sentences.zh: 认为它是一个企业“坏分子”，可能会被拿来杀鸡儆猴。

sentences.en: that it's kind of this corporate bad doer and that it might be made an example of.
sentences.zh: 于是恐慌真正开始了。

sentences.en: And so that's when the panic really starts to begin.
sentences.zh: 突然间，人们开始担心，传言四起，说恒大实际上处于破产边缘。

sentences.en: And suddenly, people start worrying, and the rumor starts that Evergrande is actually on the verge of bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们开始接触那些生活受到恒大影响，在某些情况下甚至被摧毁的人们。

sentences.en: And that's when we start reaching out to people whose lives have been affected and, in some cases, destroyed by Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 那么亚历克斯，告诉我们你遇到的那些人，他们的生活是如何被恒大内部的问题颠覆的。

sentences.en: So Alex, tell us about these people that you met, whose lives have been upended by the problems inside Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 8月份，我们开始尝试寻找尽可能多的人，我们认为他们可能受到了恒大危机的影响。

sentences.en: So in August, we start trying to find as many people as we can who we think may have been affected by Evergrande's crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从购房者开始。

sentences.en: And so we start with homebuyers.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了一个叫韦斯利·张的人。

sentences.en: And we find this guy named Wesley Zhang.
sentences.zh: 他33岁，他告诉我们四年前他买了一套还没完工的公寓。

sentences.en: He's 33 years old, and he tells us that four years ago, he bought an apartment that hadn't been completed yet.
sentences.zh: 当时，他支付了13.8万美元的首付，这基本上是他父母的毕生积蓄和他自己的一些积蓄。

sentences.en: And at the time, he puts down $138,000, which is basically the life savings of his parents and some of his own savings.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始在此基础上每月支付抵押贷款。

sentences.en: And then he starts making monthly mortgage payments on top of that.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他已经支付了40多期的月供。

sentences.en: And at this point, he's made more than 40 monthly payments.
sentences.zh: 四年过去了，他还是没见到那套公寓。

sentences.en: And it's four years later, and he still hasn't seen the apartment.
sentences.zh: 它还没完工。

sentences.en: It's not finished.
sentences.zh: 它还没完工。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so what we learn in our reporting is that this guy, Wesley Zhang, is actually just one of some 1.6 million people who, just like him,
sentences.zh: 我们在报道中了解到，这个叫张韦斯利（Wesley Zhang）的人，其实只是那160万名和他一样的人之一，

sentences.en: put money down for an apartment that Evergrande, because of its problems, has not been able to finish.
sentences.zh: 他们为恒大的公寓付了钱，但由于恒大自身的问题，这些公寓至今未能完工。

sentences.en: So there are now a lot of people who have poured their life savings into homes and into the dream that Evergrande has created of a middle-class existence,
sentences.zh: 所以现在有很多人把毕生积蓄都投入到了房子里，投入到了恒大所营造的中产阶级生活梦想中，

sentences.en: and they've got nothing in return.
sentences.zh: 结果却一无所获。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's a lot of angry homebuyers.
sentences.zh: 有很多愤怒的购房者。

sentences.en: And we start talking to other people who are affected by Evergrande, and we come across this contractor named Yong Zhuxiang, who's from a city in central China.
sentences.zh: 我们开始采访其他受恒大影响的人，遇到了这位名叫雍竹祥（Yong Zhuxiang）的承包商，他来自中国中部的一座城市。

sentences.en: And he and his workers finish their job with Evergrande in May.
sentences.zh: 他和他的工人在五月份完成了恒大的工作。

sentences.en: But he tells us that he hasn't been paid since February.
sentences.zh: 但他告诉我们，从二月份开始他就没拿到钱。

sentences.en: And at this point, Evergrande owes him half a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 目前，恒大欠他五十万美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it's not just him, because he's hired a bunch of workers to help him with the job.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是他，因为他还雇了一大批工人来协助完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And at this point, he's worried that his whole business is basically going to collapse.
sentences.zh: 现在，他担心自己的整个生意基本上要垮了。

sentences.en: And so that's the story of homebuyers and contractors who are affected by Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 这就是受恒大影响的购房者和承包商的故事。

sentences.en: But what really surprised us at this point in our reporting was that employees also were deeply affected by Evergrande's troubles.
sentences.zh: 但我们在报道中真正感到惊讶的是，员工也深受恒大困境的影响。

sentences.en: So we come across this guy named Jincheng, who's 28, and he works for Evergrande in the eastern city of Hefei.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了一个叫金成（Jincheng）的人，他28岁，在东部城市合肥为恒大工作。

sentences.en: And he tells us in April of this year, his bosses basically said, you need to stump up a certain amount of money.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，今年四月，他的老板基本上说，你们需要凑出一笔钱来。

sentences.en: For him, it was $62,000.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这笔钱是6.2万美元。

sentences.en: And invest it in this high-interest investment product, but give us the money.
sentences.zh: 投资到这个高收益理财产品里，但钱要交给公司。

sentences.en: So it was basically like a short-term high-interest loan.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上就像是一笔短期的高息贷款。

sentences.en: And we later learned that 70% to 80% of Evergrande employees across the country were told that they needed to hand over some amount of money as a loan.
sentences.zh: 后来我们了解到，全国70%到80%的恒大员工都被告知需要上交一笔钱作为贷款。

sentences.en: And that if they didn't come up with that money, that their bonus would be docked.
sentences.zh: 如果他们拿不出这笔钱，奖金就会被扣除。

sentences.en: So it was sort of strong-armed, right?
sentences.zh: 这算是一种强迫，对吧？

sentences.en: And Jincheng, the employee we spoke to, told us that he didn't feel like he had an option.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的员工金成告诉我们，他觉得没得选。

sentences.en: So Evergrande is forcing its employees to bail out their employer because it has so recklessly been borrowing and has run out of money.
sentences.zh: 所以恒大是在强迫员工救助公司，因为恒大此前借贷太鲁莽，现在没钱了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And many employees said they borrowed from parents and in-laws.
sentences.zh: 许多员工说他们是从父母和岳父母那里借的钱。

sentences.en: Some said they put in hundreds of thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 有些人说他们投入了数十万美元。

sentences.en: And some of these high-interest loans that were packaged as investment products, they were meant to be paid in September.
sentences.zh: 而其中一些包装成理财产品的高息贷款，本应在九月份偿还。

sentences.en: And so everything's starting to come to a head.
sentences.zh: 所以一切都开始集中爆发了。

sentences.en: Evergrande has been chastised by the government.
sentences.zh: 恒大受到了政府的严厉批评。

sentences.en: Rumors of its bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 破产的传言。

sentences.en: Are spreading on the internet.
sentences.zh: 正在互联网上蔓延。

sentences.en: And at the same time, they're telling employees who are expecting their money back, plus an interest, that they have to wait.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们却在告诉那些等着拿回本金和利息的员工，他们必须等待。

sentences.en: And so that's when employees start panicking.
sentences.zh: 于是员工们开始恐慌。

sentences.en: And that's when they start joining others, homebuyers and contractors, suppliers, in actually protesting.
sentences.zh: 他们开始加入购房者、承包商和供应商的行列，进行抗议。

sentences.en: Like actual protesting on the streets?
sentences.zh: 你是说真的在街头抗议？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which is unusual for China.
sentences.zh: 这在中国很不寻常。

sentences.en: We're talking groups of 50 or 100.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是50人或100人的群体。

sentences.en: These aren't massive protests.
sentences.zh: 这些不是大规模的抗议。

sentences.en: Not like what you might think happens in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 不像你在美国看到的那种。

sentences.en: But there's one scene at one point where investors and homebuyers crowd into the lobby of Evergrande's headquarters in Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 但有一次，投资者和购房者挤进了恒大深圳总部的大厅。

sentences.en: And it's super chaotic.
sentences.zh: 场面非常混乱。

sentences.en: And outside, you just see these police with these giant riot shields.
sentences.zh: 在外面，你只能看到那些拿着巨大防暴盾牌的警察。

sentences.en: And it disappears as quickly as the protests started.
sentences.zh: 抗议消失得和开始时一样快。

sentences.en: And then all we see after, for days later, are the police officers with their riot shields outside the headquarters of Evergrande.
sentences.zh: 之后几天，我们看到的只有恒大总部外拿着防暴盾牌的警察。

sentences.en: So this is more than just a company imploding at this point if you're the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是中国政府，这不仅仅是一家公司倒闭的问题。

sentences.en: This has all the makings of potentially social unrest, something that is very, very unusual in China.
sentences.zh: 这具备了引发社会动荡的潜质，这在中国是非常、非常罕见的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But just as quickly as we see these protests, they're silenced as they always are.
sentences.zh: 但我们看到这些抗议的同时，它们也像往常一样被迅速平息了。

sentences.en: And some protesters later tell us that they're contacted by the police and intimidated.
sentences.zh: 一些抗议者后来告诉我们，他们受到了警察的联系和恐吓。

sentences.en: And at this point, Evergrande is really starting to run out of money and out of time.
sentences.zh: 此时，恒大真的开始没钱了，时间也不多了。

sentences.en: And this is sort of mid-September.
sentences.zh: 这大约是在九月中旬。

sentences.en: It hasn't been able to raise money by selling off parts of its business.
sentences.zh: 它没能通过出售部分业务来筹集资金。

sentences.en: It's also run out of other ways to find money, like tapping employees.
sentences.zh: 它也用尽了其他找钱的方法，比如向员工伸手。

sentences.en: And probably more important than anything else, no one is buying any of its apartments.
sentences.zh: 而且可能最重要的是，没有人买它的房子了。

sentences.en: And that's when things get really bad.
sentences.zh: 事情就是在那时变得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Because Evergrande is days away from this deadline for a really important interest payment that it owes to foreign investors.
sentences.zh: 因为恒大距离一笔欠外国投资者的重要利息支付截止日期只剩几天了。

sentences.en: And that day comes.
sentences.zh: 那一天到来了。

sentences.en: There was no sign that ailing Chinese developer Evergrande paid $83 million in interest payments it owed offshore bondholders.
sentences.zh: 没有迹象表明陷入困境的中国开发商恒大支付了欠离岸债券持有人的8300万美元利息。

sentences.en: And Evergrande doesn't make the payment.
sentences.zh: 恒大没有支付这笔款项。

sentences.en: The Thursday deadline for the payment came and went with complete silence from the firm.
sentences.zh: 周四的付款截止日期在公司的完全沉默中过去了。

sentences.en: So at this point now, Evergrande is at risk of defaulting.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，恒大面临违约风险。

sentences.en: And the whole world is now watching.
sentences.zh: 全世界都在注视着。

sentences.en: And you start to see headlines raising the question.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到标题提出疑问。

sentences.en: With liabilities of $305 billion, Evergrande has sparked concerns of a messy collapse.
sentences.zh: 恒大拥有3050亿美元的负债，引发了人们对混乱倒闭的担忧。

sentences.en: If Evergrande defaults on its debt.
sentences.zh: 如果恒大债务违约。

sentences.en: That could spread through China's financial system and reverberate around the world.
sentences.zh: 那可能会蔓延到中国的金融体系，并波及全球。

sentences.en: Is this going to lead to some kind of financial crisis in China?
sentences.zh: 这会导致中国出现某种金融危机吗？

sentences.en: So Alex, explain that.
sentences.zh: 那么亚历克斯（Alex），解释一下。

sentences.en: How could the collapse of Evergrande produce a larger financial crisis in China?
sentences.zh: 恒大的倒闭怎么会引发中国更大的金融危机？

sentences.en: How would that work?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Well, consider this scenario.
sentences.zh: 嗯，考虑一下这个情景。

sentences.en: So Evergrande disappears.
sentences.zh: 恒大消失了。

sentences.en: And that spills over into the broader housing market.
sentences.zh: 这会蔓延到更广泛的房地产市场。

sentences.en: And you start to see properties lose value.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到房产贬值。

sentences.en: Then you see new property prices start to plummet.
sentences.zh: 然后你会看到新房价格开始暴跌。

sentences.en: Then homes start to become worth less than the mortgages that people are paying on them.
sentences.zh: 然后房子的价值开始低于人们支付的抵押贷款。

sentences.en: And then there are all the companies and the banks and the financial institutions that Evergrande owes money to.
sentences.zh: 接着是所有那些恒大欠钱的公司、银行和金融机构。

sentences.en: And they start to find themselves in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他们开始发现自己陷入了困境。

sentences.en: And then finally, panic starts to set in.
sentences.zh: 最后，恐慌开始蔓延。

sentences.en: Doubts grow about all these other companies like Evergrande that have so much debt that maybe they can't go on either.
sentences.zh: 人们对所有像恒大这样负债累累的其他公司产生了怀疑，也许他们也撑不下去了。

sentences.en: And so that's the thing about financial panic.
sentences.zh: 这就是金融恐慌的特点。

sentences.en: It's all about fear and emotion.
sentences.zh: 一切都关乎恐惧和情绪。

sentences.en: And those are things that are really hard to contain.
sentences.zh: 这些东西真的很难控制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the problem is if Evergrande goes under, lots of people get hurt, which is part of the financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，如果恒大倒闭，很多人会受损，这是金融危机的一部分。

sentences.en: But the part of a financial crisis that would be hard to predict would be the fear that there are lots of little Evergrandes dotted around the Chinese economy.
sentences.zh: 但金融危机中难以预测的部分是，人们会担心中国经济中到处都是小恒大。

sentences.en: And if that fear starts to grow, that's what a financial crisis would look like.
sentences.zh: 如果这种恐惧开始增长，那就是金融危机的样子。

sentences.en: People might pull their money out of those companies.
sentences.zh: 人们可能会从那些公司撤资。

sentences.en: Investors might demand their money back.
sentences.zh: 投资者可能会要求还钱。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, the entire Chinese economy is on the brink of some sort of collapse.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，整个中国经济就处于某种崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in that scenario, it's kind of like what we saw in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这有点像我们在美国看到的那样，

sentences.en: in 2008, which was a big shock to one industry suddenly undermining confidence in an entire economy.
sentences.zh: 2008年，一个行业的巨大冲击突然破坏了整个经济的信心。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine that China has some kind of a plan to help Evergrande get through this and avoid that nightmare scenario you just outlined, Alex.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须想象，中国有某种计划来帮助恒大度过难关，避免你刚才描述的噩梦场景，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: And so are they gearing up the Chinese government to essentially bail out Evergrande?
sentences.zh: 那么中国政府是否正在准备实质上救助恒大？

sentences.en: That's the thing.
sentences.zh: 问题就在这里。

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: We don't actually know what the government is going to do.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上不知道政府会怎么做。

sentences.en: There's actually a very good chance that China will let Evergrande fail.
sentences.zh: 事实上，中国很有可能会让恒大倒闭。

sentences.en: So why would that be?
sentences.zh: 那为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why would China not bail out Evergrande?
sentences.zh: 为什么中国不救助恒大？

sentences.en: Because China thinks that they can actually avoid that nightmare scenario.
sentences.zh: 因为中国认为他们实际上可以避免那种噩梦场景。

sentences.en: I think the Communist Party believes it has the power to eventually pay the contractors and make sure that all the suppliers that Evergrande owes money to will in some way get some of the money they're owed.
sentences.zh: 我认为共产党相信它有能力最终支付承包商的费用，并确保恒大欠钱的所有供应商都能以某种方式得到他们应得的部分款项。

sentences.en: That the homebuyers who are waiting on apartments, that those apartments ultimately get built by someone.
sentences.zh: 确保那些等待公寓的购房者，最终能由某人把房子建好。

sentences.en: Because the last thing that the Communist Party is willing to sacrifice is political instability.
sentences.zh: 因为共产党最不愿意牺牲的就是政治稳定。

sentences.en: If that means making sure that ordinary people are made somewhat whole in the fallout of this, they will go to extraordinary lengths to make sure that happens.
sentences.zh: 如果这意味着要确保普通人在这次事件中得到某种程度的补偿，他们会不惜一切代价确保这一点。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that is just not good for China because at this point in their trajectory, they want to create economic growth that the wider population can participate in.
sentences.zh: 这对中国来说并不是好事，因为在他们发展的这个阶段，他们想要创造更广泛人群都能参与的经济增长。

sentences.en: And so letting Evergrande fail, potentially, you're saying, puts China on a better, healthier, more sustainable, fairer,
sentences.zh: 所以你是在说，让恒大倒闭，可能会让中国走上一条更好、更健康、更可持续、更公平、

sentences.en: more equal economic path that is in line with what the Chinese Communist Party says are its values.
sentences.zh: 更平等的经济道路，这符合中国共产党所说的价值观。

sentences.en: And so China can live with the potential short-term pain of an Evergrande collapse because what it gets in return is just a better long-term China.
sentences.zh: 所以中国可以忍受恒大倒闭带来的潜在短期痛苦，因为换来的是一个更好的长期中国。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But by letting Evergrande fail, maybe China can start to move its economy away from this speculative model of borrowing and borrowing that has created these huge bubbles.
sentences.zh: 但通过让恒大倒闭，也许中国可以开始将其经济从这种创造了巨大泡沫的借贷模式中转移出来。

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, what does all of this say about the Chinese economic experiment that started 40 years ago, as you told us,
sentences.zh: 那么归根结底，这一切对于你告诉我们的40年前开始的中国经济实验，

sentences.en: and that Evergrande and its founder have really come to embody?
sentences.zh: 以及恒大及其创始人真正体现的那个实验，说明了什么？

sentences.en: Does this in some ways mean that that economic experiment has failed?
sentences.zh: 这是否在某种程度上意味着那个经济实验失败了？

sentences.en: It's hard to say that the past 40 years of China's economic growth has been a failure if you just look at all the people who have been lifted from poverty.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看所有脱贫的人口，很难说过去40年的中国经济增长是失败的。

sentences.en: I think the better way to look at it is that this moment is a test for just how socialist China is.
sentences.zh: 我认为更好的看待方式是，这一刻是对中国社会主义程度的考验。

sentences.en: You know, it's run by the Chinese Communist Party, but for four decades, it's really been, in many parts of the economy, just the Wild West in terms of capitalism.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它是由中国共产党领导的，但四十年来，在经济的许多部分，它实际上就像是资本主义的“狂野西部”。

sentences.en: This change that needs to happen in this moment in time is a test of whether the Chinese Communist Party is really serious about its socialist roots.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻需要发生的这种变化，是对中国共产党是否真的认真对待其社会主义根基的考验。

sentences.en: You know, this idea that everybody should partake in the wealth of the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种每个人都应该分享国家财富的理念。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Because what happened with Evergrande was not adhering to that socialist vision.
sentences.zh: 因为恒大发生的事情并没有坚持那种社会主义愿景。

sentences.en: I mean, I think if you look at Xu at the height of his success, there was an incredible amount of excess.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你看看许家印在成功巅峰时期的样子，那真是极度的奢靡。

sentences.en: For somebody to be able to, on a whim, spend $100 million on a yacht, that's not really in line with kind of core socialist principles.
sentences.zh: 一个人可以随心所欲地花1亿美元买游艇，这并不真正符合核心社会主义原则。

sentences.en: What's also happening in the backdrop here at the moment is China's leader, Xi Jinping, is talking a lot about this idea of common prosperity.
sentences.zh: 目前背景下也在发生的事情是，中国领导人习近平正在谈论“共同富裕”的理念。

sentences.en: And it's not new.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: It's something that Mao talked about and every Chinese leader has talked about.
sentences.zh: 这是毛泽东谈论过的，也是每一位中国领导人都谈论过的。

sentences.en: But it could actually mean something right now.
sentences.zh: 但它现在可能真的意味着什么。

sentences.en: Because if China, let's ever can fail, and the authorities are serious about pivoting its economy and creating a society where wealth is more evenly distributed,
sentences.zh: 因为如果中国让恒大倒闭，而当局认真对待经济转型，创造一个财富分配更均匀的社会，

sentences.en: that would get the party a little bit closer to its theoretical roots.
sentences.zh: 那将使党更接近其理论根基。

sentences.en: Well, Alex, we appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，亚历克斯，感谢你的时间。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: I think we're pretty much there now.
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在差不多谈妥了。

sentences.en: You think you have a deal now?
sentences.zh: 你认为现在达成协议了吗？

sentences.en: We're almost there.
sentences.zh: 快了。

sentences.en: It's just the language of it.
sentences.zh: 只是措辞的问题。

sentences.en: On Sunday, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi told CNN that after nearly a month of tense negotiations,
sentences.zh: 周日，众议院议长南希·佩洛西告诉美国有线电视新闻网（CNN），经过近一个月的紧张谈判，

sentences.en: Democrats are on the verge of a deal to pass a historic bill that will expand the social safety net as soon as this week.
sentences.zh: 民主党人即将达成一项协议，通过一项历史性法案，最早将于本周扩大社会安全网。

sentences.en: It is less than we had was projected to begin with, but it's still bigger than anything we have ever done in terms of addressing the needs of America's working families.
sentences.zh: 这比我们最初预计的要少，但在解决美国工薪家庭需求方面，它仍然比我们以往做过的任何事情都要大。

sentences.en: The bill had started with a price tag of nearly $3.5 trillion, but is expected to be trimmed down to a cost of less than $2 trillion at the urging of two moderate senators,
sentences.zh: 该法案最初的预算约为3.5万亿美元，但在两位温和派参议员的敦促下，预计将削减至不到2万亿美元，

sentences.en: Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema.
sentences.zh: 他们是乔·曼钦（Joe Manchin）和克里斯滕·希尼玛（Kyrsten Sinema）。

sentences.en: The spending bill is expected to be passed in tandem with a $1.2 trillion infrastructure bill, which together represent the centerpiece of President Biden's domestic agenda.
sentences.zh: 这项支出法案预计将与一项1.2万亿美元的基础设施法案同时通过，两者共同构成了拜登总统国内议程的核心。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Luke Vander Plukk, Stella Tan, and Alexandra Lee Young.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由 Luke Vander Plukk、Stella Tan 和 Alexandra Lee Young 制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and Mark George and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由 Lisa Chow 和 Mark George 编辑，Chris Wood 负责工程。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Joy Dong.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢 Joy Dong。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 主题音乐由 Wonderly 的 Jim Brunberg 和 Ben Landsverk 创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是 Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter 秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝断片儿的睡法。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》App 或您喜爱的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter 秀》。
